PART III — LANDS

No. 1948/35 – THURSDAY, JANUARY 07, 2016
EXTRAORDINARY
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Notice under Section 7
My No.: 6/3/7/15/11/6. Land Ministry’s Ref. No.: LD/05/2007/MV/117G.

I, hereby declare under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, as amended by the land Acquisition (Amendment) Act No. 28 by 1964, the government intends to acquire the following land which is required for Moragahakanda, Kaluganga Development Project.
Description of the Land to be Acquired: Public purpose means the land Acquisition for the Moragahakanda and Kaluganga Development Project.

The lands described below shown in Sheet No. 45 of supplement 63 in Topo PP 18 prepared by Surveyor General, situated at Elagamuwa Village in Elagamuwa Grama Niladhari Division, Gangala Pallesiya Pattuwa Minor Division of Naula Divisional Secretary’s Division, Matale District, Central Province.

THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Notice under Section 7
My No.: 6/3/7/15/11/6. Land Ministry’s Ref. No.: LD/05/2007/MV/117G.

I, hereby give Notice, under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, as amended by the land Acquisition (Amendment) No. 28 by 1964, that Government intends to acquire the following lands which is required for Moragahakanda , Kaluganga Development Project.
